asset_kinds.CONTAINER_FBX: Physical FBX file containing potential mesh objects.
asset_kinds.MESH_OBJECT: Logical asset entity, not necessarily a standalone file.

rules.no_fabrication: Do not fabricate physical files for logical mesh objects if the container does not contain them.
rules.semantic_split: If one container maps to multiple folders, report SEMANTIC_SPLIT_REQUIRED instead of splitting the file.
rules.uasset_handling: Production filesystem moves of .uasset are blocked (BLOCKED_UE_ASSET_API) to prevent breaking UE internal references.
